text: A pharmacist reported that tablets from lot ABC123 caused a patient to experience nausea after taking the medication.
A patient called to report that several tablets from lot XYZ789 of Acme Pain Relief 200mg appeared discolored. No one took the tablets and no injury was reported.
A nurse called the medical information line asking whether Acme Pain Relief 200mg tablets can be crushed for a patient with a feeding tube.
Someone mentioned Acme Pain Relief tablets on a call but the call disconnected before any further details were given.
A reporter described lot DEF456 of Acme Allergy Relief 10mg as having cracked tablets. The patient, a 42-year-old woman, took one tablet and experienced dizziness.
